full_judgment: "When there is specific provision for appeal the court cannot exercise its inherent power under section 151 of the Code of Civil Procedure. As such the learned Judge of the High Court Division rightly held that the learned Assistant Judge has committed an illegality in interfering with the final decree under section 151 of the Code of Civil procedure." In view of the decision, discussions and reasons stated above, I find that the learned District Judge has committed an error of important question of law in rejecting the Civil Revision affirming the order of the trial court. Accordingly, I find merits in the Rule.
